text:
Jessica (Support): Customer says promo code shows as "Applied" in UI but their credit balance/usage hasn't changed. Org: org_9c3f2b, user: user_87a. They hit the green check in the UI and got a confirmation email. Can we triage?

Priya (Support): Thanks Jess — forwarding logs. Customer reports redeem time 2025-11-20T14:32:10Z. They attached a screenshot of the UI confirmation. No ledger entry in our internal view so far.

Kevin (Billing): I pulled the ledger for org_9c3f2b — no insert for that time. We do have a webhook ack from partner that returned 200. Possible race or mapping issue to billing account. Any webhook id or claim id?

Jessica (Support): Claim id is claim_5b9f; webhook callback id callback_8842. Copy of callback payload below: ```{
  "claim_id": "claim_5b9f",
  "org_id": "org_9c3f2b",
  "amount_cents": 5000,
  "status": "accepted",
  "timestamp": "2025-11-20T14:32:12Z"
}``` The UI shows applied amount $50.00.

Sam (Eng-Platform): Quick checklist: 1) Was the callback processed by the promo-ingest worker? 2) Was the ledger write acknowledged by DB? 3) Any errors in retry queue?

Kevin (Billing): I checked the ingest logs; callback_8842 shows in logs: "received" then "enqueued for ledger write" but no "ledger write success" entry. There's a transient DB timeout around 14:32:13Z in the same window. Could be aborted transaction.

Sam (Eng-Platform): Can you paste the worker log snippet? small chunk is fine.

Kevin (Billing): ```INFO 2025-11-20T14:32:13.203Z promo-ingest worker processing callback_8842
ERROR 2025-11-20T14:32:13.217Z ledger-write failed: timeout from db
INFO 2025-11-20T14:32:13.300Z promo-ingest worker retrying ledger-write (attempt 1)
ERROR 2025-11-20T14:32:13.412Z ledger-write failed: duplicate-key (tx rolled back)
WARN 2025-11-20T14:32:13.500Z aborting claim processing: inconsistent state
```

Priya (Support): So the worker retried then got duplicate-key — interesting. Customer hasn't been charged and has no credit. What does duplicate-key indicate here?

Sam (Eng-Platform): Could indicate partial write earlier (an idempotency token) then the rollback left state inconsistent. Need DB trace for tx id. For now, manual fix: create ledger entry and reconcile invoice mapping, but must be careful to avoid double-apply.

Jessica (Support): Customer needs credits asap. Can billing do manual credits and we'll follow with a rollback if necessary? Also want to tell customer next steps.

Kevin (Billing): I can apply an emergency credit to org_9c3f2b for $50 and mark the record as "manual-override". I'll also flag the claim id so we don't auto-apply when/if the ingest completes. Will follow up with the DB trace request.

Sam (Eng-Platform): I'll open an incident ticket for the transient DB timeouts and include worker trace and the tx id once Kevin shares it. Also will add a safe-apply guard to the ingest worker to detect rollback+duplicate-key pattern.

Priya (Support): Messaging for customer: "Thanks — we applied the $50 credit manually to your account and flagged the promo claim as safe. We're investigating a transient processing error, and you will not be double-credited. Apologies for the confusion, we expect a follow-up in <24 hours." Thoughts?

Jessica (Support): Sounds good. I'll send that + the manual credit receipt. Marking this escalated to billing+platform. :white_check_mark: 

billing-bot: Invoice update: manual credit of $50 applied to org_9c3f2b by Kevin (Billing) at 2025-11-20T15:02:05Z. Reference: manual-credit-1998765432

Kevin (Billing): Done. I also requested tx trace from infra — they confirmed a transient connection issue to primary DB at 14:32:13Z which caused the write to fail and left idempotency key state inconsistent. Eng will handle follow-up.

Sam (Eng-Platform): Filing follow-up work: - Add stronger idempotency handling in promo-ingest - Add alert for duplicate-key after rollback - Postmortem if we see more than 3 occurrences in 24h. Ticket: INFR-4721

Priya (Support): Closing loop: Jess, can you confirm customer notified and happy with manual credit?

Jessica (Support): Notified and customer confirmed receipt of $50 credit and appreciated the quick turnaround. Will keep thread open until eng closes INFR-4721.

Kevin (Billing): Marking thread resolved on our side.

Sam (Eng-Platform): Thanks all.
